correctness.rationale: Av(231,312,321) consists exactly of direct sums of decreasing layers of size one/two, i.e. Fibonacci compositions. For each denominator b≥2 the b words W_j=112(22)^(j−1)12(22)^(b−j)22 have identical weight, exactly three 1s and 2b+2 2s, and are pairwise cross-bifix-free. Replacing the earliest occurrence by another W_j preserves total permutation size and cannot create an earlier match, yielding exact equinumerosity of all b earliest-hit types at every finite n. The inversion relation plus layer representative and successor predicates express each fixed word and its earliest occurrence in FO with position/value orders. Fixed prefix composition measures tend to iid weights φ^(−1), φ^(−2); independent disjoint windows imply any designated word eventually occurs with probability→1. Therefore every rational a/b∈[0,1] is an FO limit probability. Independent cross-bifix/weight check for b=2..15 corroborates; the infinite argument is structural.
